-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvStorage` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def isStorage (st : Storage) : IProp GF :=
  isStorageWith (ownStorage st) (appendTok st) (appendedTok st) (storCut st) (storFloor st) (storCert st) st

theorem storApp_pend (σ : StorState) (q pend : List EntryM) : storApp { prev := σ.prev, ents :=
    σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := q, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd :=
    σ.hd } pend = storApp σ pend

theorem appendHold_persistent (st : Storage) (es : List EntryM) (ts : List w64) : Persistent
    (appendHold st es ts)

structure StorageModel.{u_1} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type u_1 where
  ownStorage : IProp GF
  appendTok : IProp GF
  appendedTok : IProp GF
  storCut : IProp GF
  storCut_persistent : Persistent (storCut st n)
  storFloor : IProp GF
  storFloor_persistent : Persistent (storFloor st x)
  storCap : IProp GF
  storCap_persistent : Persistent (storCap st k)
  storCut_cap : storCut st n ∗ storCap st k ⊢ ⌜n ≤ k⌝
  storCert : IProp GF
  storCert_persistent : Persistent (storCert st k)
  storTermsAt : IProp GF
  storTermsAt_persistent : Persistent (storTermsAt st ts)
  storTermsAt_intro : ownStorage st σ ⊢ |==> (ownStorage st σ ∗ storTermsAt st ts)
  storTermsPre : IProp GF
  storTermsPre_persistent : Persistent (storTermsPre st ts)
  storTermsPre_intro : ownStorage st σ ⊢ |==> (ownStorage st σ ∗ storTermsPre st ts)
  storTermsAt_receipt : storTermsPre st ts ∗ appendedTok st σ p ⊢ |==> (appendedTok st σ p ∗ storTermsAt st ts)

theorem isStorage_handout [package_sem : Assumptions] (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) (p : List
    EntryM) (Hpo : σ.pend = [] ∧ (p ≠ [] → PendOk σ p ∧ PendAbove σ p ∧ HdAbove σ p)) : ⊢ isStorage
    st -∗ ownStorage st σ ==∗ ownStorage st { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p,
    scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd } ∗ appendRight st p

theorem storCap_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (k : Int) : Persistent (storCap st k)

def appendHold (st : Storage) (es : List EntryM) (ts : List w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜es = []⌝ ∗ storTermsAt st ts ∨ ⌜es ≠ []⌝ ∗ storTermsPre st ts)

def storApp (σ : StorState) (pend : List EntryM) : List EntryM :=
  match pend with
  | [] => σ.ents
  | e0 :: tail => List.take (uint.Z e0.Index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents ++ pend

def PendAbove (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e0 : EntryM), p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z σ.fl < uint.Z e0.Index'

def appendRight (st : Storage) (p : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = []⌝ ∨ ∃ σ, appendTok st σ p)

theorem appendHold_receipt (st : Storage) (es : List EntryM) (ts : List w64) : ⊢ appendHold st es ts
    -∗ appendReceipt st es ==∗ appendReceipt st es ∗ storTermsAt st ts

def HdAbove (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e0 : EntryM), p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z σ.hd < uint.Z e0.Index'

theorem storTermsPre_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (ts : List w64) : Persistent (storTermsPre st ts)

def appendReceipt (st : Storage) (p : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = []⌝ ∨ ∃ σ, appendedTok st σ p)

theorem storCert_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (k : SnapTrip) : Persistent (storCert st k)

structure StorState : Type where
  prev : entryID
  ents : List EntryM
  ss : entryID
  pend : List EntryM
  scs : CSLists
  sal : Bool
  sdat : List w8
  fl : w64
  hd : w64

def PendOk (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  p ≠ [] ∧
    ∀ (e0 : EntryM),
      p.head? = some e0 →
        uint.Z σ.prev.index' < uint.Z e0.Index' ∧
          uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length + 1 ∧
            ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), p[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑k

theorem storFloor_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (x : w64) : Persistent (storFloor st x)

theorem storPast_pers (st : Storage) (m : Int) : Persistent (storPast st m)

theorem storPast_of_cut (st : Storage) (n : Int) : storCut st n ⊢ storPast st n

theorem storCut_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (n : Int) : Persistent (storCut st n)

def TermsOn (σ : StorState) (ts : List w64) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j t : w64), uint.Z σ.prev.index' < uint.Z j → ts[uint.nat j - 1]? = some t → termAt σ.prev σ.ents j = some t

def storAbsorb (σ : StorState) : StorState :=
  { prev := σ.prev, ents := storApp σ σ.pend, ss := σ.ss, pend := [], scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
    fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }

def termAt (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) (i : w64) : Option w64 :=
  if uint.Z i = uint.Z prev.index' then some prev.term'
  else (fun e => e.Term') <$> ents[(uint.Z i - uint.Z prev.index' - 1).toNat]?

def isStorageWith (P : StorState → IProp GF) (AT DT : StorState → List EntryM → IProp GF) (CT : Int
    → IProp GF) (FW : w64 → IProp GF) (SC : SnapTrip → IProp GF) (st : Storage) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ i,
      "%Hstok" ∷ ⌜st = GoInterface.ok i⌝ ∗
        ("#HLastIndex" ∷
            ∀ σ,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  P σ ∗ ⌜σ.pend = []⌝ -∗
                    (▷
                        ∀ li,
                          ⌜uint.Z li = uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length⌝ ∗ P σ -∗
                            Φ (intoVal li, intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"LastIndex" i.v))
                          (intoVal ()))
                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
          ("#HFirstIndex" ∷
              ∀ σ,
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    P σ -∗
                      (▷
                          ∀ fi,
                            ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z fi ∧
                                    uint.Z fi ≤ max (uint.Z σ.prev.index') (uint.Z σ.fl) + 1⌝ ∗
                                (⌜uint.Z fi = uint.Z σ.prev.index' + 1⌝ ∨ CT (uint.Z fi - 1)) ∗ P σ -∗
                              Φ (intoVal fi, intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                        WP
                          ((intoVal
                              (methods i.ty go!"FirstIndex" i.v))
                            (intoVal ()))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
            ("#HTerm" ∷
                ∀ σ i0 ec,
                  □
                    ∀ Φ,
                      P σ ∗
                          ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z i0 ∧ uint.Z i0 ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length⌝ ∗
                            ⌜PendFrom σ (uint.Z i0 + 1)⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
                        (▷
                            ∀ t err,
                              (⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ termAt σ.prev σ.ents i0 = some t⌝ ∨
                                    ⌜err = ec ∧ uint.Z i0 < uint.Z σ.fl⌝ ∗ CT (uint.Z i0 + 1)) ∗
                                  P σ -∗
                                Φ (intoVal t, intoVal err)) -∗
                          WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Term" i.v)) (intoVal i0)) {{ Φ }}) ∗
              ("#HEntries" ∷
                  ∀ σ lo hi maxSize ec,
                    □
                      ∀ Φ,
                        P σ ∗
                            ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z lo ∧
                                  uint.Z lo < uint.Z hi ∧ uint.Z hi ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length + 1⌝ ∗
                              ⌜PendFrom σ (uint.Z hi)⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
                          (▷
                              ∀ s es err,
                                ⌜err = ec ∧ uint.Z lo ≤ uint.Z σ.fl⌝ ∗ CT (uint.Z lo) ∗ P σ ∨
                                    ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                      entsRO s es ∗
                                        ⌜es ≠ [] ∧
                                              ↑es.length ≤ uint.Z hi - uint.Z lo ∧
                                                (∀ (e : EntryM),
                                                    e ∈ es →
                                                      e ∈ List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents) ∧
                                                  s.cap = s.len ∧
                                                    es <+:
                                                      List.drop (uint.Z lo - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat
                                                        (List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents)⌝ ∗
                                          P σ -∗
                                  Φ (intoVal s, intoVal err)) -∗
                            WP
                              ((((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Entries" i.v))
                                    (intoVal lo))
                                  (intoVal hi))
                                (intoVal maxSize))
                              {{ Φ }}) ∗
                ("#Hbounded" ∷ □ ∀ σ, P σ -∗ ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length < 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗ P σ) ∗
                  ("#HSnapshot" ∷
                      ∀ σ esu n,
                        □
                          ∀ Φ,
                            P σ ∗
                                typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrSnapshotTemporarilyUnavailable) esu DFrac.discard ∗
                                  (⌜n ≤ 0⌝ ∨ CT n) -∗
                              (▷
                                  ∀ snap err,
                                    P σ ∗
                                        (⌜err = esu⌝ ∨
                                          ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                            ∃ sv,
                                              ownSnapM snap (DFrac.own 1) sv ∗
                                                ⌜(σ.prev.index' ≠ W64 0 ∨ 1 ≤ n → sv.Metadata'.Index' ≠ W64 0) ∧
                                                      (snapId sv = σ.ss ∧
                                                          sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave' = σ.sal ∧
                                                            sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists = σ.scs ∧ sv.Data' = σ.sdat ∨
                                                        uint.Z σ.ss.index' < uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                                                          uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                                                            uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ uint.Z σ.hd ∧
                                                              termAt σ.prev (storApp σ σ.pend) sv.Metadata'.Index' =
                                                                some sv.Metadata'.Term')⌝ ∗
                                                  (⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = W64 0⌝ ∨
                                                    SC (snapTrip sv sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists))) -∗
                                      Φ (intoVal snap, intoVal err)) -∗
                                WP
                                  ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Snapshot" i.v))
                                    (intoVal ()))
                                  {{ Φ }}) ∗
                    ("#Hhandout" ∷
                        □
                          ∀ σ p,
                            P σ -∗
                              ⌜σ.pend = [] ∧ PendOk σ p ∧ PendAbove σ p ∧ HdAbove σ p⌝ ==∗
                                P
                                    { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                      sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd } ∗
                                  AT σ p) ∗
                      ("#Habsorb" ∷
                          □
                            ∀ σ1 σ p,
                              P σ1 -∗
                                DT σ p ==∗
                                  ⌜{ prev := σ1.prev, ents := σ1.ents, ss := σ1.ss, pend := σ1.pend, scs := σ1.scs,
                                          sal := σ1.sal, sdat := σ1.sdat, fl := σ1.fl, hd := σ.hd } =
                                        { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs,
                                          sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }⌝ ∗
                                    P (storAbsorb σ1)) ∗
                        "#Hfloor" ∷
                          □
                            ∀ σ x h,
                              P σ -∗
                                ⌜(σ.pend = [] ∨ x = σ.fl) ∧
                                      uint.Z σ.fl ≤ uint.Z x ∧
                                        uint.Z σ.hd ≤ uint.Z h ∧
                                          uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z h ∧
                                            (x = σ.fl ∨ uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length) ∧
                                              (h = σ.hd ∨
                                                uint.Z h ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑(storApp σ σ.pend).length)⌝ ==∗
                                  P
                                      { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs,
                                        sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := x, hd := h } ∗
                                    FW x)

theorem storPast_one (st : Storage) (x : w64) : storPast st (uint.Z x + 1) ⊢ storPast st 1

def PendFrom (σ : StorState) (n : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e0 : EntryM), σ.pend.head? = some e0 → n ≤ uint.Z e0.Index'

theorem isStorage_pers (st : Storage) : Persistent (isStorage st)

theorem isStorageWith_pers (P : StorState → IProp GF) (AT DT : StorState → List EntryM → IProp GF)
    (CT : Int → IProp GF) (FW : w64 → IProp GF) (SC : SnapTrip → IProp GF) (st : Storage) :
    Persistent (isStorageWith P AT DT CT FW SC st)

theorem storPast_mono (st : Storage) (m m' : Int) (h : m' ≤ m) : storPast st m ⊢ storPast st m'

theorem storTermsAt_pers.{u_1} (st : Storage) (ts : List w64) : Persistent (storTermsAt st ts)

def storPast (st : Storage) (m : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n, ⌜m ≤ n⌝ ∗ storCut st n)

theorem storPast_cap (st : Storage) (m k : Int) : ⊢ storPast st m -∗ storCap st k -∗ ⌜m ≤ k⌝

theorem isStorage_raise [package_sem : Assumptions] (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) (h : w64) (Hh :
    uint.Z σ.hd ≤ uint.Z h ∧ uint.Z σ.fl ≤ uint.Z h ∧ uint.Z h ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑(storApp σ
    σ.pend).length) : ⊢ isStorage st -∗ ownStorage st σ ==∗ ownStorage st { prev := σ.prev, ents :=
    σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd
    := h }
